feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Denmark says it thwarted 'Russian plot' to kill US-Ukrainian rapper
articles.summary: Police thwarted a Russian plot to kill a US-Ukrainian rapper who was performing in Denmark, according to authorities.

articles.title: Anthropic among big fallers in global stock market rout
articles.summary: Shares in Anthropic have fallen by more than 10% at Friday's open on Wall Street, just a day after their record-breaking Nasdaq debut, as part of a global stock market rout.

articles.title: Myanmar rejects UN court's genocide ruling as 'unfair'
articles.summary: Myanmar branded a ruling by the UN's highest court that its security forces conducted state-sponsored genocide against Rohingya Muslims as "unfair".

articles.title: England handed suspended away ticket ban for fans' chants during Spain win
articles.summary: England have been given a suspended away ticket ban by UEFA for "racist and/or discriminatory behaviour" by their fans during a match with Spain in Madrid on Sunday.

articles.title: Thomas Markle fit to stand trial over child abuse images, US court rules
articles.summary: Thomas Markle is fit to stand trial on charges of possessing child sexual abuse material, a US court has ruled.

articles.title: UK conducting offensive cyber ops against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, says top commander
articles.summary: The UK is conducting offensive cyber operations against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, a top military commander has for the first time revealed.

articles.title: Burnham says Europe 'ready to enter negotiations' to help end Russia's war in Ukraine
articles.summary: Europe is ready to enter negotiations to help end Russia's war in Ukraine, Andy Burnham has said.
